**MSci Physics with Theoretical Physics, First Class**  
University of Nottingham

Theoretical physicist interested in quantum gravity, holography, quantum field theory, geometry, and mathematical physics.

I am currently seeking funded PhD opportunities for 2027/28 in mathematical physics, quantum gravity, holography, and related areas.

## Research

My research explores connections between quantum gravity, quantum field theory, geometry, gauge theory, holography, and mathematical physics, with a particular interest in how fundamental physical structures such as spacetime, time, geometry, and observables emerge and are encoded in mathematical theories.

[Research](research.html) · [CV](cv.html) · [Contact](contact.html) · Referees available on request.

## Interests

Quantum gravity · Holography and AdS/CFT · Quantum field theory · Operator algebras and AQFT · Gauge theory · Differential geometry and topology · Emergent geometry
